subject: Renewal + onboarding refresh: procurement steps & SOW amendment

Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal + onboarding refresh: proposed steps

Hi Sam / Acme procurement team,

Following our renewal conversation last week, attached is a single-file summary of the proposed renewal and onboarding refresh to streamline procurement:

- Renewal term: move from 12 -> 24 months (requested by product team to lock pricing)
- Capacity change: increase committed capacity to 2x (move to Dedicated pool)
- One-time onboarding refresh required by Acme procurement (updated contacts, SOC 2 evidence, updated W9)
- Proposed discount: 12% on committed usage for 24-month term; standard rates for overage

Attachments: redwood-renewal-quote-Acme-2026.pdf, madp-security-evidence.zip

Ask: Can you start the vendor re-onboarding flow in your procurement portal and confirm the PO template or a PO number? If you prefer, we can send a SOW amendment for signature (DocuSign link pending) and then you can issue PO.

I copied Marissa to coordinate legal/terms and Soojin for security evidence. Happy to jump on a quick call if helpful.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0183

Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 11:34:00 -07:00

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the summary — we can proceed but need the following before we initiate the portal workflow: 

1) Completed vendor re-onboarding packet (updated company contact, EIN, W9, insurance cert)
2) Latest SOC 2 Type II evidence and a point-of-contact for security questions
3) Completed SOW amendment showing the 24-month term and committed capacity lines

We have a PO template attached for your convenience (acme_po_template.docx). Once vendor is approved in our portal and legal signs the SOW, we will issue a PO. Please also include a boxed summary of costs so our finance team can expedite approvals.

Sam Wright
Procurement Manager
Acme, Inc.

Karthik — thanks for the ping. I reviewed the SOW amendment draft and the pricing box. Legal is OK with the 24-month term language as-is, but requests a clause to clarify failure-to-pay remedies (standard). I approve the one-time onboarding credit up to $6,000 to offset the portal re-onboarding fee (please capture as a line item on the SOW).

Soojin — can you confirm the SOC2 bundle contains the 2025 test report and a contact (name/email) so Acme can reach out if they have follow-up questions? If not, we should provide a short cover letter explaining the artifacts.

Neha — please prepare a single-sheet cost summary keyed to Acme's PO template (use the attached acme_po_template.docx as the target).
